texts: Confirmed that the root cause was a nonexistent ~/.config/cursor directory and that Cursor crashed while persisting workspace trust state before the harness could accept the dialog.
The root cause was that ~/.config/cursor did not exist, and Cursor crashed while persisting workspace trust state before the harness could send "a".
The established root cause was a nonexistent ~/.config/cursor directory while Cursor persisted workspace trust state, killing the pane before the helper could accept trust.
